description_en: Queries the server certificates in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域的服务器证书列表
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-server-certificates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server-certificate-id 123157900000000_166f8204689_1714763408_709981430 --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtop0000 --tag Value=1 Key=test --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServerCertificates

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Classic Load Balancer instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query region IDs.

If the endpoint of the selected region is slb.aliyuncs.com, `RegionId` is required
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID。

当您所选地域的Enpoint（服务地址）为slb.aliyuncs.com时，`RegionId`必填
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the server certificate
parameters.name: server_certificate_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify this parameter, it cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify this parameter, it can be an empty string.
The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

AliCloudCertificateId.description_en: The ID of the server certificate in Alibaba Cloud Certificate Management Service
AliCloudCertificateId.description_zh: 阿里云证书服务的服务器证书ID

AliCloudCertificateName.description_en: The name of the server certificate in Alibaba Cloud Certificate Management Service
AliCloudCertificateName.description_zh: 阿里云证书服务的服务器证书名称

CommonName.description_en: The domain name, which corresponds to the `CommonName` field of the certificate

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the server certificate was uploaded. The time is displayed in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 服务器证书上传的时间。时间格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`，采用 UTC 时间

CreateTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp when the server certificate was uploaded
CreateTimeStamp.description_zh: 服务器证书上传的时间戳

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time. The time is displayed in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format in UTC
ExpireTime.description_zh: 过期时间。时间格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`，采用 UTC 时间

Fingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint of the server certificate

IsAliCloudCertificate.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is from Alibaba Cloud Certificate Management Service. Valid values:

1: yes.
0: no
IsAliCloudCertificate.description_zh:
是否是阿里云证书服务中的证书：

1：是。
0：不是
